newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul joins chemical arms non-proliferation body.
newsitem.headline: Seoul joins chemical arms non-proliferation body.

text.p: South Korea has joined the Australian Group, an international body seeking the non-proliferation of biochemical weapons, an official at the Seoul foreign ministry said on Wednesday.
The official said South Korea on Tuesday joined the 30 member group which includes the United States, Japan and major European Union states.
"By joining the Australian Group, our country will be able to contribute to international efforts to prevent proliferation of biochemical weapons," he said.
The group, launched in 1985 to control the production and proliferation of biochemical weapons, invited Seoul to a general session to begin on October 14 in Paris, the official said.
Some North Korean defectors have said Pyongyang possesses powerful chemical weapons. South Korea has remained technically at war with the Stalinist North since the 1950-53 Korean War.
